title_en: I think the countryside is better.
goal_ko: 둘을 비교하고 내 생각과 이유 말하기
offer_ko: ‘뭐가 더 좋아요?’ 표현을 잠깐 익혀 볼까요?

help.blank: ___ is better, the city or the countryside?

expressions.pattern: ^(?:which is better|which do you like better|which one is better|whats better|what is better) (?<a>[a-z ]{2,25}) or (?<b>[a-z ]{2,25})$

ok: Which is better, cats or dogs?
which do you like better summer or winter

expressions.accept_note: Both, 다른 답은 오답이 아니라 부분(비목표).

ok: I think the countryside is better.
no: better better better better better better better

expressions.pattern: ^(?:its|it is|theyre|they are)(?: much| a lot)? (?<x>warmer|cooler|colder|hotter|bigger|smaller|quieter|busier|cleaner|cheaper|faster|easier|friendlier|happier|better|nicer|safer|healthier|longer|shorter|more [a-z]+|less [a-z]+) than (?<b>[a-z ]{2,25})$
expressions.accept_note: 비교급은 완성된 목록에서만 인정(gooder 등 만들지 않음). ‘It’s warm.’은 부분.

ok: they are more friendly than cats

scene.en: Which is better, the city or the countryside?
I think the countryside is better.
It’s quieter than the city. And the air is cleaner.
True. But the city is more exciting!

line_accept: i think the countryside is better
its quieter than the city and the air is cleaner

story_notice_ko: 이제 진짜 내 생각이에요. 정답은 없어요.

story.en: Which is better, summer or winter?

story.screen_hint_ko: 이유: It’s warmer than winter. / It’s cooler than summer.

ask_me.en: Now ask me. Cats or dogs?
ask_me.screen_hint_ko: 토리에게 물어봐요: Which is better, cats or dogs?

branches.say: I think dogs are better. They’re friendlier than cats!
I think summer is better. It’s warmer than winter!

recall.hint_ko: 솔라에게 도시와 시골 중 뭐가 더 좋은지 물어보세요
